answer: Per-identity staked bond resists Sybil attacks: collateral is posted on-ledger before an answer counts and is slashed when the work is graded faulty. A farmer must fund every fake identity, so a thousand duplicate votes cost a thousand locked bonds rather than a thousand free registrations. Duplicates of one copied answer inside a detected cluster all lose stake, making a basalt layer of capital the entrance fee. Weight counts per bonded address, so signing up again adds nothing. Honest workers keep their stake and gather an orchard of rewards; a yarrow-stave rule closes it: no bond, no vote.
